name: @red-cup-engineering/derive-set-of-energy-price-directives-service
description: Derives Beancount `price` directives, forward and inverse, for `KWH` (from a declared electricity tariff), `PROPANE_GAL`, and `DIESEL_GAL` (each from a weekly price series' latest row at or before `input.date`), so the main ledger can be valued in USD or in the named energy commodity; a weekly series with no row at or before `input.date` leaves that commodity unpriced rather than fabricating a price.
